people.name: Egypt

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
translations.bsb: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city—figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where their Lord was also crucified.
